c1-21-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Growth and Pay
c1-21-01.scenario: You have read a news report about a factory where production is growing. Károly asks whether the workers are better off.
c1-21-01.prompt: Tell Károly that production is growing but the workers' pay is not.
c1-21-01.target: Jóllehet a gyár termelése nő, mindamellett a munkások bére alig emelkedik.
c1-21-01.english: Although the factory's output is growing, nonetheless the workers' pay is hardly rising.
c1-21-01.canDo: I can grant one fact and set a problem against it (*jóllehet … mindamellett*, *noha … ugyanakkor*).

c1-21-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Layoffs in the News
c1-21-02.scenario: You have read a news report about a factory layoff. Károly asks what happened.
c1-21-02.prompt: Tell Károly what happened at the factory, without saying who did it.
c1-21-02.target: Tavaly háromszáz dolgozót bocsátottak el a gyárból.
c1-21-02.english: Last year three hundred workers were laid off from the factory.
c1-21-02.canDo: I can say what happened without naming who did it, as Hungarian news reports do (*háromszáz dolgozót bocsátottak el, a kapuk le vannak zárva*).

c1-21-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Result for the Workers
c1-21-03.scenario: You have read a report about a company that cut shifts. Károly asks what the cut meant for the workers.
c1-21-03.prompt: Tell Károly what the company did and what it caused for the workers.
cues: Add the result with a participle
c1-21-03.target: A cég leépítette a műszakokat, létbizonytalanságot teremtve a dolgozók között.
c1-21-03.english: The company cut the shifts, creating insecurity among the workers.
c1-21-03.canDo: I can add a result to a sentence with a *-va/-ve* participle (*bérletörést okozva*, *létbizonytalanságot teremtve*).

c1-21-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Pay and Prices
c1-21-04.scenario: You have read a report about factory workers' pay. Károly asks what happened to it.
c1-21-04.prompt: Tell Károly how much the workers' pay changed because of prices.
cues: Say how much it fell, and why
c1-21-04.target: A gyári munkások bére drasztikusan csökkent a drágulás miatt.
c1-21-04.english: The factory workers' pay fell drastically because of rising prices.
c1-21-04.canDo: I can say how much pay or prices changed (*számottevően*, *drasztikusan*, *kirívóan*, *elenyésző mértékben*).

c1-21-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Employer Owes
c1-21-05.scenario: You have read the text about Nagy Lajos. Károly asks what workers should be able to expect today.
c1-21-05.prompt: Tell Károly one thing an employer must do for workers.
c1-21-05.target: A munkáltató köteles biztonságos munkafeltételeket biztosítani a dolgozóknak.
c1-21-05.english: The employer is obliged to provide workers with safe working conditions.
c1-21-05.canDo: I can state a duty and a right (*köteles biztosítani*, *elidegeníthetetlen jog*, *kógens szabály*).

c1-21-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Workers' Situation
c1-21-consolidation.scenario: You have read a report about a factory. Károly asks you to sum it up.
c1-21-consolidation.prompt: Grant one good fact about the factory and say what is still wrong for the workers.
c1-21-consolidation.target: Noha a gyár nyereséges, ugyanakkor a dolgozók bére drasztikusan csökkent.
c1-21-consolidation.english: Although the factory is profitable, at the same time the workers' pay has fallen drastically.
c1-21-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for precarious work, wages and workers' rights.
